summary.text: Travis Weaver is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 93, in office since January 2023, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business executive, he has worked as a chief financial officer and as a strategic business planning manager at Caterpillar Inc.

paragraphs.text: Travis Weaver earned an M.B.A. from Northwestern University in 2020.

His career experience includes working as a chief financial officer with ElectroBrew, Inc., a strategic business planning manager with Caterpillar Inc., and a financial analysis and budget intern with Nissan Motor Corporation.

He served as education committee chairman and a board member of Wildlife Prairie Park, a GED tutor with the Moonlight Coalition for Adult Learning, and a board member of the CASA of the Tenth Judicial Circuit.
Weaver assumed office in the Illinois House on January 11, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Appropriations-Public Safety, Consumer Protection, Housing, House Insurance, Personnel & Pensions, and Revenue & Finance committees.
